submission.reasoning: On workstation5, an interactive cmd.exe (proc-29da349e7e) running as WORKSTATION5\wardog with high integrity launched bitsadmin.exe (proc-826bdb1e01). It ran '/transfer /Download /priority Foreground' to pull a file from raw.githubusercontent.com (Atomic Red Team T1197) and save it as C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\bitsadmin1_flag.ps1. A DNS/network record for raw.githubusercontent.com (conn-96c2a572b6) appears in the graph. Using a BITS job to download a file named as a PowerShell script into the user's Temp folder is MITRE technique T1197 (BITS Jobs), a living-off-the-land way to download tools. The graph has no file entity for the download, so I couldn't confirm it landed on disk. Response: isolate the host, block the download endpoint, delete the downloaded file if it is there, and rotate the wardog credentials.
